title: tricholaena leucantha
intro: Tricholaena leucantha, commonly known as Silver Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tricholaena leucantha include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
